resolution.note: detachedShipArgs resolves --worktree absolute; test/ci/ship-live.test.ts; fast PASS

title: detached ship with a relative --worktree resolves it twice and dies with git ENOENT
body: krn pr ship --detach --worktree .krn/worktrees/<id> (a relative path, as the usage line shows) dies at once with 'spawnSync git ENOENT' in ship.log: startDetachedShip (src/ci/ship-live.ts) spawns the child with cwd = worktree but passes the same relative --worktree in argv, so the child resolves it against the worktree and gets a path that does not exist.

Outcome: a detached ship started from the repository root with a relative --worktree runs its git calls in the right worktree; a regression test that fails on the base passes (exit 0).
Proof: regression test under test/ci for startDetachedShip or its argv/cwd builder.
